about.title: About
about.p1: I'm Jashan — a cybersecurity enthusiast from Sirsa, India, focused on building a career in penetration testing, web security, and digital forensics.
about.p2: I have hands-on experience identifying and mitigating vulnerabilities like SQL injection (SQLi), cross-site scripting (XSS), CSRF, broken access control, broken authentication, and IDOR. Beyond web security, I explore binary exploitation and conduct OSINT investigations to uncover digital footprints and analyze online threats.
about.p3: Today I work on AI Automation & Intelligent Solutions at CSRBOX — exploring workflow automation, LLMOps, and agentic AI. My goal is to ethically strengthen security systems, protect sensitive data, and contribute to creating a safer digital environment.

currently.title: Currently
currently.description: I'm a selected intern of the IBM SkillsBuild Academic Internship 2026 at CSRBOX (BharatCares Group, in collaboration with AICTE) — working on AI automation, intelligent solutions, workflow orchestration, and fine-tuning LLMs for domain-specific applications. I'm also pursuing a BTech in Artificial Intelligence at Jan Nayak Ch. Devi Lal Vidyapeeth, Sirsa (2025–2029). Always eager to learn, collaborate, and grow in the cybersecurity community.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.description: Hands-on experience across AI automation, intelligent solutions, and cybersecurity. Selected intern at CSRBOX on AI Automation & Intelligent Solutions (IBM SkillsBuild 2026), with prior internships in OSINT and cybersecurity & forensics at Cyber Secured India. I combine security-first thinking with intelligent automation to build systems that are both smart and safe.

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: I don't separate security from development — they're the same conversation. I start with the problem, test with intent, and document everything. I ask questions before I run a scan. I push back when something doesn't protect the goal. And I stay involved end-to-end — because context is where good security lives.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: I got into cybersecurity because the digital world needs people who defend it. Every vulnerability closed is a breach prevented. That still drives me — to build intelligent systems that are not just capable, but trustworthy.

whatToExpect.title: What to expect
whatToExpect.description: Clarity from day one. I scope carefully, communicate directly, and flag problems early. I bring perspective, not just execution. If something can be better, I'll say so. Work that holds up — secure, documented, and built to last.
